note: DTD normal eligibility corrected across the site. The public notice and the explorer still carried the V16.0 text: 'Normal DTD does NOT change', a #29,900-#30,000 update window presented as mandatory, and the jackpot PoW window as 5,000 blocks. From #30,000 (V16.1) DTD-normal eligibility DOES change - recency 288 blocks at every height, the 6-block recent-PRODUCER cooldown yields when applying it would leave the draw with nobody, and the 10%/288 anti-dominance gate is armed only at >=11 distinct miners; a lone active miner can therefore take 100% of the block. The jackpot PoW window is 2,016 blocks. The explorer's eligibility timeline also carried a wrong number of its own (it called the V15 recency window '2016', crossing it with the V16.1 jackpot window) - corrected, and a V16.1 era added. Operators may update to v16.1.0 at any time before #30,000; the old 'not earlier, not later' advice is withdrawn.
